name: flipthememe-contracts
description: Solidity dependencies that ship only via npm. RedStone's consumer contracts are excluded from their public GitHub monorepo, so forge install cannot reach them; they are declared here and reached through a foundry remapping instead of being copied into src/. Versions are pinned exactly, not caret-ranged: PrimaryProdDataServiceConsumerBase hardcodes the five authorised signer addresses every price in this protocol is trusted against, and package-lock.json is gitignored repo-wide, so the pin is the only thing standing between us and a silent change to that set.
